# Dremio Community Tools

> A curated catalog of community-maintained and official tools, SDKs, libraries, and AI-agent resources for the Dremio Data Lakehouse. Maintained by Alex Merced (Dremio Developer Relations).

URL: https://tools.choosedremio.com/

## Python Libraries
- [dremio-simple-query](https://github.com/developer-advocacy-dremio/dremio_simple_query): Effortless analytics with Arrow Flight — connect Pandas, Polars, and DuckDB to Dremio.
- [dremioframe](https://github.com/developer-advocacy-dremio/dremio-cloud-dremioframe): DataFrame API for the lakehouse; manage catalog, reflections, and data as code.
- [alt-dremio-cli](https://github.com/developer-advocacy-dremio/dremio-python-cli): Community fork of the Dremio CLI with 100% API coverage for GitOps and automation.
- [dremio-local-mcp](https://github.com/AlexMercedCoder/dremio-local-mcp): Unofficial Python MCP Server for Dremio.
- [pydremio](https://github.com/continental/pydremio): Python SDK by Continental for Dremio.

## JavaScript
- [dremiojs](https://github.com/developer-advocacy-dremio/dremiojs): Type-safe JavaScript SDK for Dremio.
- [dremio-n8n-connector](https://github.com/developer-advocacy-dremio/dremio-n8n-connector): n8n Community Node for Dremio.

## AI Coding Assistant Tools
- [Dremio Agent Skill](https://github.com/developer-advocacy-dremio/dremio-agent-skill): AI coding context and skills for Claude Code, Cursor, and others.
- [DREMIO-AGENT.MD](https://github.com/developer-advocacy-dremio/dremio-agent-md): Agent instructions file for Dremio-aware AI coding.
- [dremio-skills-bundle](https://github.com/developer-advocacy-dremio/dremio-skills-bundle): Curated AI agent skills for Dremio.

## Official Dremio Tools
- [dbt-dremio](https://github.com/dremio/dbt-dremio)
- [claude-plugins](https://github.com/dremio/claude-plugins)
- [@dremio/js-sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dremio/js-sdk)
- [dremio-cli](https://github.com/dremio/cli)

## Sample Code
- [dremio-examples](https://github.com/developer-advocacy-dremio/dremio-examples)
